messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to bump runtime -> v0.15.0, API -> v1.8.0, console -> v2.3. Want to align merges before tomorrow's 18:00 UTC cutoff.
ken: ack. which repos need manual changelog entries vs auto?
sara: runtime + api need manual CHANGELOG.md entries. console and sdk will be generated from the release notes script.
anita: @maria do you want me to handle the console tag+release? I can take it after QA gates pass.
maria: that'd be great @anita. I'll open the runtime PR in ~15m. PR title: "runtime: v0.15.0 (compat fixes + kv cache)"
ryan: pinging infra — any CI queue issues today? we've got longer macrotasks in beta but nothing affecting release lanes afaik.
ci-bot: ci-bot: runtime-PR #842 started, 3/5 checks passing, flaky test(s) noted: tests/kv_cache_test.py::test_eviction (re-run advised)
ken: re-run CI and if still flaky, we should isolate the test not to block the bump. don't want to delay the tag.
sara: changelog snippet for API v1.8: "improve token accounting for streaming responses; bugfix: 429 handling on short bursts". I'll paste into the PR body.
maria: adding the changelog now. also leaving a canary route for console that points at api v1.8 for smoke tests.
anita: console PR opened: console#510 title "release(console): v2.3.0" — needs approval from @ken for the UX prop change.
ken: reviewing now. small nits only. will approve after CI green.
ryan: note for dedicated customers: runtime v0.15 has a quantization change that requires node restart. ops alerted via ticket INF-1276.
maria: thanks. tagging support: @here please watch for increased restarts during the deploy window 19:00-19:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for console:v2.3.0 at 19:00 UTC; environment=staging
ci-bot: ci-bot: runtime-PR #842 finished: 5/5 checks passing after re-run.
sara: merging api#1298 in 5m once the runtime tag is pushed. api tests are green locally for the new token bookkeeping.
maria: pushing runtime tag now: git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "runtime v0.15.0: kv cache and perf fixes" && git push origin v0.15.0
anita: console tag pushed and release notes generated. publish job in progress.
ken: approved console PR, merging.
maria: ok merging runtime now. after merges, please bump SDKs (js/python) to reference API v1.8.0 — sara can you coordinate with SDK owners?
sara: on it. I'll open PRs in sdk-js and sdk-py with updated package.json / pyproject and changelog link.
ryan: quick check — anyone expecting breaking client changes? API v1.8 is backward compatible aside from stricter 429 semantics.
maria: no breaking changes expected. patching note in release blog.
anita: staging canary looks clean. no user-facing regressions in smoke tests.
sara: sdk PRs opened: sdk-js#77, sdk-py#43. requesting reviews from @devex.
ken: let's give QA till 20:00 UTC to finish regression, otherwise we'll proceed with full roll at 20:30 with automatic fallback to previous runtime if error rate > 2%.
maria: agreed. thanks everyone. I'll drop a final status update here at 20:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
